verdict.rationale: cubic documents a built-in AI assistant users can hand work to. They can ask the in-product chat to tour a PR or explain selected code, mention @cubic-dev-ai in PR comments to trigger reviews and fixes, and click "Fix with cubic" to have it generate a fix and push it to the branch. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the assistant and fix delegation, and evidence of delegating tasks beyond PR review and fix scope (the chat sidebar page sits under archived docs).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: cubic generates the fix and pushes it to your PR branch.
Ask chat to "tour this PR" for a step-by-step review of the changes and what to check.
Select code and choose **Add to AI chat** to ask about it with the diff and codebase as context.
Interact with cubic in PR comments to ask questions, trigger reviews, and fix issues.
cubic can automatically fix issues identified during code review. Request a targeted fix with one click.
